{{Quote|The Lake Retreat Hotel offers elegant rooms, superb conference facilities, and the most attentive service for its guests.|Rovim Minnoni|<ref name="AED" />}}
The '''Lake Retreat Hotel''' was [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lake Retreat Hotel was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
